rationale: Kaede helps developers build IoT and embedded solutions at Seeed Studio, while Prabhjot brings deep hardware-silicon expertise from Apple with a developer tools background. They can exchange perspectives on making hardware more accessible to developers—Kaede's field application experience with makers and IoT platforms complements Prabhjot's CPU design knowledge and infrastructure thinking.
intro_message: Kaede Lin, meet Prabhjot Singh Kohli — Kaede helps developers build IoT solutions at Seeed Studio, and Prabhjot's CPU silicon work at Apple plus interest in developer tools could spark useful conversations about the hardware-developer intersection.
